description: Holder Count History. Calls only GET /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/holders-count-ts and returns that response. Pass startTime and endTime as unix seconds. endTime minus startTime must be at most 2592000 seconds (30 days). interval is hour or day.

endTime.description: End of the window as a unix timestamp in seconds. Required with startTime, and at most 30 days (2592000 seconds) later.

interval.description: Time bucket: hour or day. The startTime to endTime window must still be at most 30 days.

mintAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/tokens/{mintAddress}/holders-count-ts.

startTime.description: Start of the window as a unix timestamp in seconds. Required with endTime. endTime minus startTime must be at most 2592000 seconds (30 days).

name: get-token-holder-count-history
title: Holder Count History
